## About
Prestige Quality Auto sits on Wesley Chapel Rd in Decatur. We fix cars, sell tires and sell cars, all from the same spot.
Our customers want to know what's going on with their vehicle and pay a fair price. A reviewer called us honest mechanics with reasonable prices, and Hakeem and Dee get mentioned by name.
We're open Monday through Saturday and closed on Sunday. Stop by or give us a call.

## Services
- A/C work: A reviewer pulled in with an A/C problem, and we got right to work. Her A/C is blowing cold again.
- Tires: Tires are part of what we do, right alongside repairs.
- Car sales: We also sell cars from our Wesley Chapel Rd location.
